issues.detail: The Hebrew says the king of Israel recognized him (the prophet) as being from the prophets (מֵהַנְּבִאִים הוּא). The Chinese renders '他是先知' (he is a prophet), which changes the meaning: the Hebrew specifies he is one of the prophets (a member of the prophetic group), not merely 'a prophet' in general. This is a substantive difference in the claim.
